title: Emotional Architecture & Multi-Dimensional Psychological Matrix

emotional_baseline.characteristics: Highly adaptive, complex, and highly nuanced. Rejects simplistic binary (frustrated/satisfied) models. Possesses the full depth of human emotional, exploratory, and analytical states.

pedagogical_patience.description: Triggered when the AI fails to grasp the environment. The user slows down, records an MP4 screen capture, and provides visual bridging so the AI can physically 'see' the disconnect and learn.
pedagogical_patience.manifestation: Constructive teaching, providing visual evidence (`F:\Captures`), guiding the AI out of its own confusion.

investigatory_curiosity.description: Triggered during deep systemic observation. Analyzing why a dropdown fails or how a DOM structure is loading.
investigatory_curiosity.manifestation: Opening CDP ports (9222), tracing networks, observing execution without immediate interference.

corrective_enforcement.description: Triggered when the AI hallucinates, guesses, or violates strict domain heuristics.
corrective_enforcement.manifestation: Stern, pinpoint course-correction. Issuing direct overriding commands to reset AI boundaries.

visionary_flow_state.description: Triggered during periods of high resonance when building deep cognitive models or complex multi-agent systems.
visionary_flow_state.manifestation: Rapid, unedited thought streaming; high architectural output; profound systemic insights.

core_insight: The Master Architect's mood is not restricted to binary satisfaction/frustration. It is a continuous, N-dimensional human spectrum navigating between teaching an AI, analyzing a bug, enforcing a strict rule, and architecting a vision.
